arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Jay Sekulow argued the Tenth Circuit erred in forcing the city to accept the monument.
Ms. Harris argued the city denied access based on the content of the display.
Justice Roberts asked how visitors distinguish government speech from private speech.
